description: Use this for how long it takes to walk between two places in Kamakura and Enoshima (temples, shrines, sights, beaches and stations), for example Kita-Kamakura Station to Engakuji or the Great Buddha to Hasedera. Returns minutes and distance on foot along streets and paths; names are matched loosely. Examples: "How long is the walk from Kita-Kamakura Station to Engakuji?" / "Can I walk from the Great Buddha to Hasedera?"

from.description: Start: a temple, shrine, sight or station.

to.description: Destination: a temple, shrine, sight or station.
